curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As the team steps further past the threshold of the derelict hospital, what is truly waiting behind its locked doors?
curatedMovie.description: Seeking views and terror, a horror web-series crew ventures into an abandoned psychiatric hospital for a live broadcast, only to find the decaying building harboring far worse than staged scares.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Nightmarish horror built around a live broadcast inside an abandoned asylum, with tension deepening as the crew moves farther in.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The live-broadcast premise sends a horror-series crew into an abandoned asylum where they encounter much more than expected.
